feat(daemon): a renderer's stored state is handed in at its start and changes only by store effects, under its name's profile (uh4)

The renderer opens no file. Its picks, drafts, settings history, doctor
marks, clicked terminals and post-mortems read come back as `store` writes,
which the host holds in memory and writes behind under the profile the
renderer's name derives. A start hands all of it back, so a restarted or
crashed renderer keeps every pick, draft and undo step. The default name
keeps today's layout; a second name writes only under its own profile.

No stored state names a path: an undo step names its layer by role, and the
config origin and client hints a click needs are the host's own session
contexts, kept across a daemon restart so a click acts before the session's
next request. The adapter's persistence entries are gone.

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.229.0
